'''Larens''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier who served in the [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]] and joined the [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Throughout the war, he became a member of [[Red Hand Squadron]] under the leadership of [[Bria Tharen]]. He was small and agile, and could thus turn off an enemy position with a paralytic [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] under fire protection. After [[Capture of the Helot's Shackle|taking]] the slave ship ''[[Emancipator (CR90 corvette)|Helot's Shackle]]'', he participated at the [[Battle of Toprawa|battle]] of [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] and perished as he and entire squadron formed a rearguard for the theft of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]].
